name: MMP Industries
why: Record quarterly sales, annual sales, annual profit
Working capital healthy - debtor days 47 to 39, inventory days 95 to 90 (not rising)
Management outlook: Building on this momentum, we expect exports to further strengthen in H2 FY27.
Latest quarter Sep 2026: Excellent (sales +35% YoY, profit +71% YoY)
Cost quality excellent: costs falling, margin expanding, operating profit growing (costs 93% to 92% of sales)
Profits backed by cash: operating cash flow is 150% of 3-year profit
risks: Credit rating BBB+/Stable (CRISIL) - weaker credit quality
Sector cycle: Weak / out of favour

guidance: Building on this momentum, we expect exports to further strengthen in H2 FY27.
Initial production has commenced at our Bhandara facility, and we expect commercial sales to gain momentum from Q4 FY '27, subject to the necessary approvals.
capex: Beginning with aluminum powders, which continues to be the foundation of our business, we witnessed strong performance during H1 FY27, supported by healthy domestic demand, robust exports and improved plant capacity work
Our larger 6,000 metric tons per annum LTPC expansion at Umred is also progressing with trials targeted for Q4 FY '28.
risks: The statements made in today's call are not a guarantee of future performance and also involve unforeseen risks and uncertainties.
Despite pricing pressures, we maintained a positive EBITDA margin through continued operational efficiency and cost management.
focus: Over the last 4 decades, MMPIL has evolved from an aluminum powder manufacturer into a diversified business, spanning aluminum powders, aluminum Foils, conductors and cables.
We are now diversifying into polymer insulators.
Our continued focus on higher value-added products and optimized product mix and economies of scale is expected to support improved realizations and margins.
